author: reek
body: NO COUNT, ADDRESS OR SYMBOL NAME IS ASSERTED, because the map in this test is a map OF this test: all three move with the binary and with the compiler that made it. What is asserted is the shape -- that a map is found at all, that it has entries, and that a name read out of one entry finds its way back to that same entry through both lookups.

author: reek
body: `map1-find` IS MENTIONED ONCE. It is a zero-argument definition, so every mention re-runs the scan of the search window; naming it in each assertion would scan the window five times over.

author: reek
body: THE MISS IS THE CONTROL. `zzz-no-such-symbol` is not in any binary, and a `map1-find-by-name` that answered Just for it would be matching something other than the name.
